notes.title: Update Plan
notes.content:
Thank you all for your support.
During the EA period, we plan to update the game on a weekly base.

The updates will consist of the following sections:
・Adding new playable characters.
・Adding new artifacts.
・Adding a new game mode.
・Adding new bosses.
・Modification for the interactive experience.
・Balancing existing artifacts.
・Fixing bugs in game.

Apart from the listed items above, 
if you have any other requests for additions or modifications, 
please feel free to let us know in our Discord channel.
We will respond to your messages as soon as possible.

notes.title: Patch 0.73
notes.content:
●New Content

　・Fixed the bug that the durability icon of artifact in the shop was displayed incorrectly in English.
